move: words snap in alternating sides, product drops with CustomBounce squash, dust bursts
how: Three headline rows snap up from masks (yPercent 115→0, expo.out, stagger 0.09) while each row shifts in from alternating ±6% xPercent; a spotlight fades up. At 0.14D an SVG shoe drops from y:-720 with rotation -14 using a CustomBounce 'drop' ease (strength 0.5, squash 3) paired with the 'drop-squash' ease on scaleX/scaleY, while a shadow grows in with power3.in; on impact at 0.32D the spot flares to scale 1.2, 16 seeded dust bits fly outward in a half-circle with power3.out and fade, a 'New drop' stamp slams in from scale 2.4 rotate 8 with expo.out, and a subline rises. The product breathes y:-6 with sine.inOut yoyo, then at 0.86D words shove up, stamp shrinks with back.in(2), the product lifts off to y:-760 and the shadow and spot fade.
adapt: Change the three headline words (mark one .acc), the subline, stamp text, and swap the shoe SVG for a product image; keep the CustomBounce strength/squash and the 0.55-1.55s drop window.
port: mount(el, shot) builds .spot, .floor, .lines rows, .sub, .stamp, .shadow, .prod and .dust with 16 generated bits; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with CustomBounce.create called once (name it per instance), offsets as fractions of D (drop 0.55/4, impact 1.28/4, exit 3.45/4) and a seeded rng for the dust. Scope selectors to el.
caveats: dust tweens need immediateRender:false as written
y:-720 drop height assumes a 720px stage
